strings.jp:
まさか貴様までが敵になろうとは…
残念だが仕方あるまい!
strings.en:
To think even you'd turn on
me... A pity, but so be it!

strings.jp:
さすがは暗殺段の長…
ぐ、ぐはぁっ……!
strings.en:
Truly the assassins'
chief... Gh, guhaah...!

strings.jp: 陛下…これ以上の抵抗は無意味です
strings.en:
Your Majesty... further
resistance is pointless.

strings.jp:
まだまだ!　その程度の力では…
この俺は倒せん!
strings.en:
Not yet! Power like that...
will never defeat me!
